label: Static Site / Markdown Blog (plain Node build)
description: A static site of markdown posts built by one Node script — pages are HTML string templates, no framework, no hydration: paginated index, post pages, tag pages, RSS + Atom feeds, sitemap, llms.txt, raw markdown per post, drafts, and per-post AI provenance from agent transcripts. `npm run build` writes dist/ for any static host

SITE_URL.description: Public origin of the site, for absolute URLs in feeds, sitemap and llms.txt

BASE_PATH.description: Sub-path the site is served from (build-time; `BASE_PATH=/my-site npm run build`)
